name: QSI_ReplaySession_Throttled_*
description: This cookie is used to stop session creation and recording due to an encountered error.

name: QSI_ReplaySession_Info_*
description: This cookie is used for identifying the session that is being recorded. This is necessary for recording page changes and reloads to be recorded on the same session.

name: QSI_CT
description: This cookie is used for tracking events. It has a counter of each event and the number of times that event has occurred.

name: _cs_same_site
description: This is a session cookie. This is a pattern type cookie where a random 13-digit number is appended to the prefix _cs_.
